name: set_timer
description: Set a countdown timer when a duration (minutes, seconds, hours) is stated.

time_human.description: The duration copied word for word, e.g. '10 minutes', '90 seconds', '1 hour 30 minutes'.

label.description: Optional name for the timer; include only when the user names one.

name: set_alarm
description: Set an alarm or wake-up call when an explicit time of day is stated.

time_human.description: The time of day copied word for word, e.g. '7:30 am', '8 pm', '6 am'.

label.description: Optional alarm label; include only when the user names one.

name: create_todo
description: Add a todo item, task, or undated reminder (like 'remind me to ...') in Google Tasks.

title.description: The task or reminder description copied word for word.
